Layer.ChangeBackgroundCommand: %function(self) self:linear(0.5) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetBackgroundPath() == nil then self:diffusealpha(0) else self:diffusealpha(0.5) end end end

Layer.InitCommand: %function(self) self:x(SCREEN_RIGHT+16) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y) self:addx(2000) self:decelerate(1) self:addx(-2000) end

Layer.CheckPositionCommand: %function(self) if not GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) then self:y(0) end end
%function(self) if not GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) then self:y(0) end end

Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:finishtweening() self:hidden(0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayFullTitle()) self:diffuse(0,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.6) self:decelerate(0.2) self:diffuse(1,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.5) else self:hidden(1) end end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:finishtweening() self:hidden(0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist()) self:diffuse(0,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.8) self:decelerate(0.15) self:diffuse(1,1,1,1) self:zoom(0.7) else self:hidden(1) end end
